# Hassan Zaki

> Computational Biology Researcher and AI Systems Engineer building end-to-end deep learning architectures and data-centric solutions for life sciences and scientific discovery.

## Projects
- [AgroGraph-Tox AI](https://hassan-ahmed-portfolio.vercel.app/#work): Multi-Task Graph Neural Network predicting acute honeybee toxicity and environmental safety.
- [Sentinel-1 SAR Flood AI](https://hassan-ahmed-portfolio.vercel.app/#work): Cloud-native radar hydrology pipeline and interactive tactical flood intelligence system.
- [EchoGuard Biometric Edge AI](https://hassan-ahmed-portfolio.vercel.app/#work): Embedded ultra-low latency acoustic keyword spotting on ESP32 microcontrollers.
- [BioPhys Conformer Benchmark](https://hassan-ahmed-portfolio.vercel.app/#work): 3D molecular conformation modeling and coordinate standardization.
- [NeuroScan SHAP Diagnostic](https://hassan-ahmed-portfolio.vercel.app/#work): Deep convolutional neural network for automated breast neoplasm triage with SHAP explainability.
- [Smart IoT Bioreactor](https://hassan-ahmed-portfolio.vercel.app/#work): Real-time closed-loop environmental telemetry and fermentation monitoring.

## Research & Open Science
- [AgroBench-3D Dataset](https://huggingface.co/datasets/Hassan2007/EcoAgro3D): 11,129 Curated 3D Molecular Conformer Benchmark on Hugging Face.
- [ORCID Profile](https://orcid.org/0009-0005-0306-0898): Verified scholarly publications and peer-reviewed research papers.
